description: June 11 birthday meaning: Gemini decan 3, birthday number 11, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a June 11 birthday falls in Gemini, in the third decan, with Mercury as the sign's ruler and Uranus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 11. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Gemini is mutable and air.

sections.heading: The June 11 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: Gemini's third decan begins on June 11th, sub-ruled by Uranus, Aquarius's modern ruler, and the birthday carries master number 11. Twenty degrees into the Twins, this is one of the more inventive dates of the year in traditional readings: quick, unconventional, intuitive about where ideas are heading. Grounding helps the lightning land somewhere useful.

Astronomically, June 11 puts the Sun near 20° Gemini in most years, inside the third ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Uranus. The last third of Gemini carries Uranus as sub-ruler, the modern ruler of Aquarius, so this decan is usually read as the most inventive and unconventional stretch of the sign. Mid-June birthdays often come with a mind that leaps ahead, connects unlikely sources and enjoys questioning the obvious. Astrologers associate these natives with technology, reform and a detached, slightly futuristic way of seeing social life. The Uranian current can make routine feel unbearable and plans change at short notice. Grounding those flashes of insight in a few steady habits tends to let the originality land where others can use it.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for June 11
paragraphs: Born on the 11th, you have a birthday number of 11, and because it is a master number it stays unreduced. The day of birth is a secondary number in numerology, yet master numbers are traditionally given extra weight wherever they appear. Two 1s side by side suggest doubled sensitivity as well as doubled initiative: the 11 is linked with intuition, inspiration and a nervous, creative charge. Those born on this date are often described as idealistic and perceptive, sometimes picking up on things before they can explain why. Grounding routines and trusted company tend to help them carry that intensity comfortably.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a June 11 birthday gives Life Path 9 for 1990, 1 for 2000, 2 for 2010 and 3 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous June 11 birthdays
paragraphs: A June birthday falls at the height of northern summer, around the longest days of the year, while in the southern hemisphere it marks the darkest stretch near the winter solstice. Gemini covers most of the month, with Cancer beginning around June 21. June is month 6 in numerology, a number of care, responsibility and home, which foreshadows the Cancerian turn at the month's end. June 11 is the 162nd day of the year (163rd in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Cancer, is usually complete within 11 days, by June 22.

By June 11 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with a June 11 birthday are Yasunari Kawabata (1899), Jacques Cousteau (1910) and Gene Wilder (1933).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is June 11?
faq.answer: June 11 is Gemini in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Gemini, which tradition links with Uranus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on June 11?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On June 11 the Life Path is 6 in 1960, 7 in 1970, 8 in 1980, 9 in 1990, 1 in 2000, 2 in 2010 and 3 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 11 for everyone born on the 11th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on June 11?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by June 11, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on June 11?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on June 11 include Yasunari Kawabata (1899), Jacques Cousteau (1910) and Gene Wilder (1933). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
